args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (18% error rate across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Response: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification shows checkout-api healthy at v2.3.0 in all three regions with a 0.2% error rate. Root cause of the v2.3.1 regression still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback complete:**
- **Service:** checkout-api — was failing health checks on v2.3.1 (18% error rate)
- **Action:** Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production
- **Verification:** checkout-api is now healthy at v2.3.0 in all three regions, error rate down to 0.2%

**Incident filed:**
- **INC-0001** (SEV2) opened for checkout-api, documenting the v2.3.1 health-check failure, the rollback action, post-rollback verification, and noting that the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression still needs investigation
- The on-call engineer has been paged
